title: DOH: Tips
description: A custom set of tips for the "Dawn of Humanity" AoT-inspired roleplaying server
body: # DOH: Tips An official resource pack for the ["Dawn of Humanity"](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/dawn-of-humanity-attack-on-titan) AoT-inspired role-playing server that adds a wide-range of custom tips to the [Tips](https://modrinth.com/mod/tips) mod on Minecraft 1.16.5. Current release: `v0.1.0` ## Requirements * Minecraft `1.16.5` * The Tips mod for `1.16.5` ## What This Pack Adds * 35 custom DOH tips under the `dohtips` namespace * DOH gameplay and server guidance tips * Regiment and rank-related tips * World, lore, and location tips * Equipment and combat tips * Flare signal tips ## Installation Put the zip into Minecraft's `resourcepacks` folder and enable it in the Resource Packs menu. ## Disabling Default Tips If you want only the custom DOH tips to appear, edit `config/tips-client.toml` and set: ``` removedNamespaces = ["tips"] ``` For Tips 1.16.5, the built-in tips use the tips namespace, not tipsmod.
